'''2001 Sacramento Enduro''' was a Star Wars CCG enduro held in Sacramento, CA on 29 September 2001. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3004">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-30-enduro-iii-9-29-01d3004/ enduro-iii-9-29-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 30 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-30-enduro-iii-9-29-01d3004/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Sacramento, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 23
